name: skool-public-calendar
description: Public iCalendar subscription feed for a Skool community
author: Cristian Tala S.

CALENDAR_KV.description: Stores the last valid generated calendar and its metadata.

GROUP_SLUG.description: Public Skool group slug, for example `cagala-aprende-repite`.

CALENDAR_NAME.description: Human-readable calendar name shown by calendar clients.

FEED_PATH.description: Public path served by the Worker, for example `/calendario.ics`.

PAST_MONTHS.description: Number of past calendar months included in each snapshot.

FUTURE_MONTHS.description: Number of future calendar months included in each snapshot.

CACHE_CONTROL.description: Cache-Control value returned with successful calendar responses.
